from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, cv2
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png'))
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
# ball region mask: hue/sat plus tight crop
mask=((hsv[:,:,0]>86)&(hsv[:,:,0]<114)&(hsv[:,:,1]>45)&(hsv[:,:,2]>35)).astype(np.uint8)
region=np.zeros(mask.shape,np.uint8); region[220:400,490:690]=1
mask*=region
n,lab,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
keep=1+np.argmax(stats[1:,4]); mask=(lab==keep).astype(np.uint8)
# include blurred fringe with contour/hull-ish dilation and soften alpha
m=cv2.dilate(mask,np.ones((7,7),np.uint8),iterations=1)
# build background by horizontal interpolation then inpaint seam
bg=im.copy(); bad=m.astype(bool)
for y in range(220,401):
 xs=np.where(bad[y])[0]
 if len(xs):
  x0,x1=xs.min(),xs.max(); left=im[y,max(0,x0-8):x0]; right=im[y,x1+1:min(1280,x1+9)]
  if len(left) and len(right):
   l=np.median(left,axis=0); r=np.median(right,axis=0); t=np.linspace(0,1,x1-x0+1)[:,None]
   bg[y,x0:x1+1]=np.clip(l*(1-t)+r*t,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
# add subtle sampled texture/noise by blending inpaint
inp=cv2.inpaint(im,m,7,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
bg=cv2.GaussianBlur(bg,(5,5),1)
bg=cv2.addWeighted(bg,0.75,inp,0.25,0)
# outside bad preserve exact
bg[~bad]=im[~bad]
Image.fromarray(bg).save('.tmp/bg_inpaint.png')
# mask vis
vis=im.copy(); vis[m>0]=(vis[m>0]*0.35+np.array([255,0,0])*0.65).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(vis).save('.tmp/ballmask.png')
print(mask.sum(),m.sum())
PY"
